title: Local transcription and burned captions (ffmpeg)
what_it_does: caption.py --transcribe makes an SRT with a local engine (parakeet-mlx, whisper.cpp, faster-whisper or openai-whisper, whichever is installed), then burns it in via ASS with pop animation and word-by-word karaoke. Also writes SRT only, or a soft subtitle track.
when_to_use: When the person wants captions or a word-timed transcript with no cloud service; the transcript also feeds the silence and mistake cutters.
why: Local, free, several engines. Burned ASS captions are a separate pipeline from HyperFrames HTML captions, so take the transcription part first and treat the burn-in as an optional fast path.
